title: pr_render.py has no way to record an intentional ticket exclusion
summary: Gave pr_render.py a supported way to record an intentional ticket exclusion as an HTML comment in the PR body (never a committed file, after a peer-caught and independently-verified squash-merge-accumulation flaw in the first design). render() omits an excluded ticket from all 5 generated sections/Closes/title; check_against_live() reads the same recorded set from the live body it already fetches.
